housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of EUR 912.50 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Faro city centre. Idealista provides a Faro rental-search page. A city-level deposit norm was not grounded.

banking.summary: Millennium bcp says account applicants need valid identification, a taxpayer number, proof of address from the last 12 months, and proof of professional status from the last 6 months; accepted documents and channels vary by applicant profile.
required_docs: Proof of address dated within 12 months
Proof of professional status dated within 6 months

schools.summary: The Faro-area directory lists Nobel Algarve British International School. Nobel's official page states that its Algarve campuses offer the National Curriculum of England/British curriculum and that Almancil offers the IB Diploma Programme; the campuses shown are in Almancil and Lagoa, not Faro city.

legal_admin.summary: For EU/EEE, Andorran and Swiss nationals staying more than three months, AIMA requires a registration certificate from the municipal council for the area of residence within 30 days after the first three months.
legal_admin.registration_step: Request the Certificado de Registo from the Câmara Municipal of the area of residence within 30 days after completing three months in Portugal; this rule is scoped to eligible EU/EEE, Andorran and Swiss nationals.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign citizen may request a NIF online through e-balcão via a legal representative or in person by appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop; identification and proof of foreign address are required.

transport.summary: Próximo is Faro's bus network (https://www.proximo.pt/). Numbeo reports a regular Faro monthly public-transport pass at EUR 37.00 (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Faro?displayCurrency=EUR).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: For an EU/EEA licence, exchange is not required before the licence expires, but a resident must register their address with IMT within 60 days of moving to Portugal. Source: https://www2.gov.pt/en/servicos/trocar-carta-de-conducao-estrangeira-por-portuguesa
transport.healthcare_registration: A foreign national is allocated an SNS user number at the first visit to a public health centre or hospital. For SNS cost coverage, the registration must also include identification, a Portuguese NIF, a full Portuguese address, and a valid residence permit. Source: https://www2.gov.pt/en/servicos/pedir-o-numero-de-utente-do-sns
